description: Configure a DHIS2 predictor for malaria epidemic threshold estimation. Log in to DHIS2 (admin/district). (1) Create a new Data Element named 'Malaria Cases Expected Threshold' (Short name: 'Mal Expected Threshold', Domain: Aggregate, Value type: Number, Aggregation: Average). (2) Create a new Predictor named 'Malaria Epidemic Threshold Predictor'. Configure it with: Output data element = 'Malaria Cases Expected Threshold' (the one you just created), Period type = Monthly, Sequential sample count = 3. In the Generator expression, select a data element for confirmed malaria cases (e.g., 'Malaria cases confirmed' or similar from the existing demo data). Save both objects.
